asked.item: date the payout for March affiliate commissions is generated

verdict.reason: The help pages state the general NET-15 payout rule and give a month-to-date example, which directly answers when a March commission's payout is generated.

steps.text: Affiliate payouts are generated on a NET-15 basis, meaning 15 days after the end of each month.
So commissions earned in March would have payouts generated on April 15th, following the page's example of September commissions producing payouts on October 15th.
Commission approval and payout timing are managed in Tolt, so you can check your Tolt affiliate dashboard for status.
